in_sanskrit.name: Rishi
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A person who is wise and learned, a spiritual guide or guru, a sage or muni, or a revered teacher.

in_hindi.name: रिशिपाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: Rishi (Sage, Teacher, or Spiritual Leader) + Pal (Servant or Protector)

in_marathi.name: Rishipal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the senses
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rishipal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rishi (sage) + Pal (master or lord of). Rishipal is a name of Lord Vishnu, signifying the master or lord of the senses.

in_bengali.name: Rishipal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the senses
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rishipal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Rishi (sage) + Pal (master or lord of). Rishipal is a name of Lord Vishnu, signifying the master or lord of the senses.
